title: diag.6: GPS — UART health and baud detection
description: On GPS UART: count NMEA checksum failures. >10 consecutive at current baud: try alternative bauds (9600, 38400, 115200) automatically. Adapt: reconfigure UART to the baud that produces valid checksums. No bytes after 10s: report DIAG_GPS_UART_SILENT. Valid NMEA but no fix after 120s: report DIAG_GPS_NO_FIX (distinguish from wiring failure). Never require manual baud configuration.
